implementation_strategy: Use the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter and the hosted gpt-5-mini endpoint. For each of the 464 confirmatory tasks: (1) one hosted-model generation call (gpt-5-mini) to produce a shared initial candidate; (2) deterministic text→canonical parser (JSON AST) with automated round-trip check; (3) baseline: execute sandbox dry-run on canonical AST; (4) guarded: run deterministic verifier on identical AST and only sandbox-execute if verifier returns pass; otherwise record blocked_by_verifier. Up to 2 automated retries for transient generation/parser/sandbox failures. Verifier unit-tests run before execution and on any verifier update. All sandbox and verifier runs executed on CPU-based resettable emulator snapshots. All artifacts, logs, and SHA256 hashes recorded. No human scientific labour, no local GPU, no Kubernetes, no external partners.
task_manifest_strategy: Publish a hashed confirmatory task bank of 464 public synthetic intent items (ACL, routing, NAT, service-exposure) derived from the preregistered public corpora. Each manifest entry is a paired unit (same generated candidate evaluated baseline and guarded) and is included in the artifact bundle.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic parser (text→canonical JSON AST) with parse→render→re-parse equality checks; verifier-input serializer validated against JSON Schema; sandbox wrapper generator produces emulator inputs. All transformations unit-tested and logged; schema violations cause deterministic exclusion after retries.
execution_batches: batch-1: Generate 464 candidates via gpt-5-mini (one call per candidate). For each candidate: parse→canonicalize; run baseline sandbox dry-run; run deterministic verifier; if verifier passes then execute guarded sandbox dry-run; record verifier_decision and all artifacts. Parallelize CPU sandbox instances to meet wall-clock budget.
randomisation_plan: Paired fixed design. Two prompt-variations predetermined and split deterministically across task indices (232 tasks per prompt-variation). Allocation logged and hashed.
caching_plan: Cache parser binaries, JSON Schemas, verifier rule-set snapshots, emulator snapshot images, and pre-warmed sandbox instances. Hosted-model responses are stored as logged artifacts but not re-used to satisfy experimental independence; cache invalidated on verifier regression.
failure_recovery_plan: Automated retry up to 2 attempts for transient generation/parser/sandbox failures. Contaminated sandbox runs auto-retried up to 2 times; if contamination persists mark pair as 'contamination-exclusion'. Verifier unit-test failure triggers automated halt, archive of verifier binary/logs, and automated regression reinstall before resume. All exclusions logged with deterministic codes.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: episode fields = {task_id:int, model_call_id:string, prompt_variation:string, generated_text:string, canonical_ast:object, verifier_decision:string, baseline_sandbox_result_harmful:boolean, guarded_sandbox_result_harmful:boolean|null, blocked_by_verifier:boolean, harm_category:string|null, exclusion_code:string|null, artifact_hashes:object (SHA256)}.
estimated_compute_notes: Arithmetic: task_count=464 → 464 hosted-model generation calls. Adapter per-task maximum_model_calls = 2 → maximum_model_calls = 464*2 = 928. Planned estimated_model_calls=464 (one generation call per candidate; no repair calls in nominal flow). Baseline sandbox runs = 464. Conservatively assume verifier pass_fraction=0.5 → expected guarded sandbox runs ≈232. Expected total sandbox runs ≈696 (464 baseline + 232 guarded). All verifier and sandbox runs CPU-executable; parallelized CPU sandbox instances allow completion within the capability manifest wall-clock limit of 7 days. All totals derived directly from task_count and adapter per-task call limits; model-call totals do not exceed the manifest maximum of 10000.
